subject: Is it possible to clear input and output objects inside a session?

messages.author: affb5acfc7bf8208
messages.subject: Is it possible to clear input and output objects inside a session?
parts:
Hi all,

I have the following problem: we currently have several shiny applications that have been written over the years by several people. Now we would like to combine them and make a single giant web application with them. The applications are not supposed to communicate between each other and share anything. The goal is just to have a single platform with all of them.

Putting the code together is not really the problem. My problem is to make sure that there is no side-effect between the apps. That means make sure there are no duplicate entries in the input and output objects. Since the apps have some similarities between them, this could happen.
I know I could make each app like a module and add specific namespaces for each app. However, some of these apps are quite big and adding a specific namespace to each of the variables would be time consuming and might cause regression problems.

So ideally what I would like would be to be able to clean my input and output objects each time I go to a different application and start anew.

Is there a way I can do that? I searched but couldn't find anything.
Is there a better way to do that?

Thank you for your answers

Sylvain

messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to clear input and output objects inside a session?
parts:
Hi Sylvain,

Here is a strawman solution on Github.

You should select an appropriate menu system for navigation (I just use a Selectize Input). The advantage of this approach is that it will keep your potential conflicts amongst inputs from colliding.
 
Best regards,
